description.value: A large-format Walmart Supercentre located in Port Alberni on Vancouver Island, offering a full range of grocery, household, clothing, and electronics departments. As one of the larger retail destinations in the region, it is a practical resupply stop for touring cyclists traversing the island. The store accepts cash and major cards.
